item.name: Search for course sections that match the supplied parameters

request.name: Search for course sections that match the supplied parameters

description.content:
{ 
                     "DisplayTitle" : "Section Search",
                     "ews_guid" : "A5877849-AE6E-409C-BDCE-EA4AAFADD0AC",
                     "LongDescription" : "Search for course sections that match the supplied parameters",
                     "ShortDescription" : "Get a list of course sections",
                     "OriginatingSchema" : [ { "source":"swssdb" }, { "source":"uweo"  }, { "source":"irws" } ],
                     "Notes" : " This resource requires any of the following ASTRA roles:
                                   - sws:Support
                                   - sws:GradeSubmitter
                                   - sws:UnitReader
                                 This resource supports the following authentication types:
                                   - X.509 Certificate
                                   - NetID
                                   - AccessToken
                                 For the Section_Search resource, the query string parameters can be configured in different ways, 
                                 depending on the desired results.
                                 To return a full listing of all the courses and sections in the curriculum, enter the year, quarter, 
                                 and curriculum abbreviation parameters.
                                 To return list of sections for a specified course, enter the year, quarter, curriculum abbreviation, 
                                 and the course number parameters.
                                 To return a list of all the sections that an instructor is teaching across multiple curricula, 
                                 enter the year, quarter and (instructor) regID parameters.
                                 To return a list of all the sections that an instructor is teaching in the specified curriculum, 
                                 enter the year, quarter, curriculum abbreviation and (instructor) regID parameters.
                                 To return a list of all the sections that a course has been offered at UW, enter the starting year 
                                 in the year field, leave quarter empty, specify the curriculum abbreviation and course number parameters.
                                 To return a list of all the sections that a course has been offered at UW but filter them for a specific 
                                 set of Delete Flag values, enter the starting year in the year field, leave quarter empty, specify 
                                 the curriculum abbreviation, course number and desired delete flag values.
                                 To return a list of all the sections that a course has but exclude courses that do not have sections, 
                                 use the exclude_courses_without_sections flag. To use this mode, you may not also search for future terms 
                                 at the same time.",
                     "Links" : ["https://metadata.uw.edu/Catalog/ViewItem/Term/studentdata.coursesection"],
                     "Synonyms" : []
                 }

query.description: RegIDs are the authoritative unique IDs guaranteed to identify a UW person permanently.  RegIDs are assigned to a person by the Identity Registration Service, the authoritative source for person data reconciled from several data sources which may represent multiple records and accounts for a single person.  A given RegID will always refer to the same person, regardless of name, status or affiliation changes.
Choose on or true or false.
Any combination of active, suspended or withdrawn separated by ,.

If you have a value in ChangedSinceDate all other input fields will be ignored and will return all data that has changed since the date entered. This is used for applications that only need the changes since they last checked without having to know specific details to search by.

Choose yes, no, or all. If yes then results will include any course that can be creditable such that it can be shown on a transcript. This would include certain classes that also fall under the Educational Outreach (EO). Yes is also the default value chosen for this search criteria if none is specified.
            If no then only classes from EO will be returned.
            If all, both transcriptable and non-transcriptable courses will be returned.
            All will return every course regardless of whether it can be included in a transcript or not.
